title: Introduce CI cache coordinator and lightweight lint gateway to reduce presubmit flakiness
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Performance: Reduced presubmit startup time and lint cold-starts by centralizing toolcache warm-up and adding a lightweight lint gateway. Telemetry: new CI tooling metrics added.
description: Motivation: presubmit CI experienced sporadic toolcache misses and repeated lint runner cold-starts that added 20-40s of variance to feedback loops. This PR adds a small, production-ready 'CI Cache Coordinator' and a 'lightweight lint gateway' to centralize toolcache warm-up signals, coordinate prefetches, and multiplex lint runs to long-lived workers. Summary of changes: 1) ci/cache-coordinator: new Go service with leader election, cache prewarm orchestration, and a gRPC health API. 2) ci/lint-gateway: minimal Node proxy that maintains language-specific worker pools and routes lint requests to reduce cold starts. 3) .github/workflows/presubmit.yml: new 'prepare-toolcache' step that queries the coordinator and optionally waits for an indicated warm signal. 4) infra/k8s/ci-deploy.yaml: deployment and service manifests for coordinator and gateway with sensible resource limits. 5) telemetry: add lightweight counters/traces (toolcache.warm, lint.gateway.hits, presubmit.cache.miss) and a short retention dashboard. 6) docs: new runbook and operator guide. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for coordinator manager and worker shutdown logic. - [x] staging e2e smoke run (200 jobs). - [x] GH Actions update behind feature-flag toggle. - [x] runbook and alerts documented. Commits (summary): - init: coordinator service skeleton - ci: add lint gateway proxy and worker pool - actions: add prepare-toolcache step and rollout toggle - telemetry: expose metrics and tag presubmit_id - fix: RBAC for staging deploy - docs: runbook and README Changed files (high-level): pkg/ci/cache/coordinator/* (new Go service), ci/lint-gateway/* (new proxy + workers), .github/workflows/presubmit.yml (workflow update), infra/k8s/ci-deploy.yaml (kubernetes manifests), tools/telemetry/metrics_registry.yaml (metrics), docs/ci/runbooks/cache-coordinator.md (new). Testing and results: Staging smoke harness ran 200 presubmit jobs with the coordinator enabled. Median presubmit startup fell from 65s to 49s (median reduction ~18s). Lint cold-start rate dropped by ~92% in the sample. Initial runs exposed an RBAC edge (worker pod lacked rolebinding for metrics); fixed in commit 5 and re-ran. CI status: build (Go/Node) green, unit tests green, lint green, e2e-smoke initially failed due to RBAC then passed after fix. Rollout plan: feature-flagged toggle default-off. Phase 1: enable for platform team for 48h, collect telemetry and SLOs. Phase 2: expand to teams with high presubmit volume and monitor toolcache.warm and presubmit.cache.miss. Migration notes: No breaking API changes for presubmit consumers. Old prepare-toolcache step remains as fallback when coordinator is off. Ops/runbook: coordinator exposes leader election and health endpoints; alert when toolcache.warm rate < 5/min or leader lease renewal > 5s. Review thread (summary): Arjun: "Ensure worker pools handle SIGTERM gracefully and drain pending requests." Author reply: "Added graceful shutdown with 30s drain window and unit tests in f0a3c". Lena: "Potential metric cardinality explosion from tags". Author reply: "Restricted tags to language and runner_type, added sampling guidance in docs". Kai: "Can we run a load test?" Author reply: "Ran a 1k-job soak in staging during the window and observed stable memory/CPU; results attached to Linear ticket." Merge: squash merged to main, merge_commit a1b2c3d4e5f6, merge method: squash. Related tracking: ENG-967 (rollout + telemetry), ENG-1003 (toolcache prewarm design). Notes: This change is intended to be low-risk with an opt-in rollout and clear rollback path. The runbook includes a kill-switch and namespace-scoped toggles.
